title: Codex Smith

hero.headline: Follow the work where the map fails.
hero.support: A recovered author and publication surface for essays, research notes, public explanations, technical arguments, and field reports emerging from Boundary First Labs.

sections.heading: Public notebook, not authority shortcut
sections.body: The publication lane exposes reasoning, artifacts, open questions, revisions, and failures without asking the author identity to substitute for evidence.

sections.heading: Multiple audiences, one source system
sections.body: Technical, civic, scientific, philosophical, and accessible public writing can project from the same governed corpus at different depths.

sections.heading: Show the work
sections.body: Claims should link outward to the object that supports them: papers, software, case studies, data, primary sources, or explicit provenance.

sections.heading: From essay to lab
sections.body: Public writing is an on-ramp into deeper methods, demonstrations, evidence, and collaboration rather than an isolated content stream.

notes: Recovered from the earlier eight-page landing-page set, originally framed around a Codexsmith/Substack publication surface.
Keep private until the current publication/channel strategy is confirmed; do not assume Substack remains the canonical route.
